facts.fact: 即便 Kiamling 等人封住裂口、挡住怪物渡海，战争仍然无法避免
facts.anchor: war was inevitable

facts.fact: 「Arrow」号开到广州后，立刻被官军逮捕
facts.anchor: The Arrow managed to reach Canton, where they were immediately arrested by imperial forces.

facts.fact: Bowring 以船属英国、Au 一家为英属香港居民为由，把这次逮捕说成冤枉
facts.anchor: the Au family residents of the British colony of Hong Kong

facts.fact: 他把「扯下英国旗、搬空鸦片舱」也列进罪名，当作开战由头
facts.anchor: he had even torn the British flag from the mast and emptied the hold of the cargo of opium

facts.fact: 离开广州前，他们四人把其余内情拼了出来
facts.anchor: Before leaving Canton, the four of them pieced together the rest of the puzzle.

facts.fact: 官府下令，禁止本地猎妖人出手干预；同行回避不只是旧怨
facts.anchor: They had been forbidden by Imperial officials from intervening.

facts.fact: 北京早知英方要在香港开裂口的计划，指望这桩蠢事自行除掉洋人
facts.anchor: Peking had known of Britain’s plans to open a rift in Hong Kong all along

facts.fact: 当地百姓成规模的死伤被算作可接受的代价
facts.anchor: The calculated decimation of the ordinary people in the region acceptable collateral.

facts.fact: 南下香港的百姓只想活命，却被两边都当成叛徒
facts.anchor: They were seen as turncoats by both sides when all they wanted was to survive.

facts.fact: 他们因在新编的叙事里成了关键，奇迹般躲过总督的怒火
facts.anchor: miraculously protected from the governor’s wrath since they had become the linchpin in the new narrative

facts.fact: 她与祖母拌嘴渐少，相处得几乎像合得来
facts.anchor: It was almost as if they got on.

facts.fact: 几周后 Beggar So 来访，带来 Jingling 早已料到的提议
facts.anchor: Beggar So came to visit with the proposition Jingling had long predicted.

facts.fact: So 说乞丐帮交给她，本来一直就是她的
facts.anchor: The Beggar Clan is yours if you want it. It always has been,

facts.fact: Por Por 只顾喝茶，说随她去，自己管不了她
facts.anchor: Do as you wish, I cannot control you.

facts.fact: 她谢绝提议，自称是猎妖人，另有打算
facts.anchor: It’s a generous offer, So sifu, but I’m a yiugwai hunter.

facts.fact: 她说答应过 Archie，要去见他的母亲
facts.anchor: I promised Archie I would speak to his mother.

facts.fact: 这桩承诺压得她睡不着；他的鬼魂饥饿，家里无人祭他
facts.anchor: His ghost was hungry; unmourned by his family back home.

facts.fact: Jingling 顺着半价船票的算法，要求把她的票也带上
facts.anchor: If Hoi gor is giving you half off, then you can afford my ticket also,

facts.fact: Por Por 拒绝同行，说香港比姐妹俩更需要她
facts.anchor: My place is here. Hong Kong needs my guidance more than the pair of you.

facts.fact: 她把 Archie 唯一的照片立在蒸笼后，点了三炷香
facts.anchor: She propped the photo behind the bamboo steamer and lit three joss sticks.

facts.fact: Lancaster 失踪、推定已死，但伦敦另有人懂鬼怪，把 Archie 当棋子派来
facts.anchor: someone else in London knew about monsters and ghosts

facts.fact: 全书末句：必要时她连太阳都要打下来
facts.anchor: she would shoot down the sun itself
